title: Summary and fair comparison of the triplet families (three RM conventions)
question: How do one-step triplets, the E040 cascade, the E041 mixed stages, Kerr MLPs and DBP compare on one 'Delta Q2 / BER reduction vs RM' picture, and does it change with the RM counting convention?

value_filter.changes_next_step: yes: decides which family is reported as the reference at each RM level

decision_if_positive: the family that leads at a level under all three conventions is reported as robustly best there
decision_if_negative: if the leader changes with the convention, the claim is stated per convention

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.robust_leader: a family is the robust leader at a level if its best-by-validation point has the highest test mean under all three RM conventions and its interval does not overlap the next family's
